Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X RS Group purchased 179,200 ordinary shares for cancellation in the week 2–6 November 2026 (daily VWAPs: 790.2522p, 787.6309p, 781.8435p, 797.7479p and 769.6248p) as part of its £100 million repurchase Programme. Since the Programme commenced the Company has bought 6,263,440 shares for cancellation, representing c.1.34% of the post-cancellation share base, leaving 467,786,028 ordinary shares in issue with no treasury shares; total voting rights are 467,786,028. All purchases were executed on-exchange under London Stock Exchange rules and will be announced weekly. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 09 November 2026 RS Group plc 9 November 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 2 November 2026 to 6 November 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
